mapper.insert: INSERT INTO apr_instance (tenant_id, business_type, business_id, document_no, status, submitted_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{businessType}, #{businessId}, #{documentNo}, 'PENDING', #{submittedBy}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE apr_instance SET status = #{status}, decided_by = #{decidedBy}, decided_at = now(), reject_reason = #{reason} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
